race.comment: SCRIPTED (4) was squeezed at a key moment yet still kept finding first-up, and with natural improvement and a cosy draw she gets the right set up to snap a long run of outs. BESIDE THE OCEAN (1) couldn't keep up with them fresh but knuckled down late and hit the line with intent. Her splits say the rise in trip will suit, so if Lloyd has her within striking range she can land a blow. TRANSCEND (6) lost the race on protest here two weeks ago but her two runs back have been the work of a more complete mare. The draw forces her back so she will be trying to round them up. AVISTA (5) keeps beating what is in front of her and now has to go up another rung, but she is in the right groove. GLASGOW LASS (2) has been solid without threatening and Grima may look to spear across and be handy.
